name: SM_Sack_Grain_PR
dresses: full grain sack lying on its side, 0.95 x 0.64 x 0.3 m: slumped flat underneath, sewn mouth with nine twine stitches and a loose tail, gusset corners

fit.colours: frames are tan, olive and madder red: MI_Prop_Hessian, MI_Prop_Hessian_Olive, MI_Prop_Hessian_Red

material_exception: shared tiling scan sets with a vertex-colour weathering layer (MI_Prop_* / MI_Struct_*), not private bakes and not yet rows of ART_STANDARD.md section 2. Edge wear, stains and soot are per-vertex. A unique bake per prop is the next step where the weaknesses say so.
known_weaknesses: Jute weave from a 0.3 m scan reads true close up, but the form is a smooth pillow with a flattened base: creases are shallow sine folds, the sewn mouth is nine loose stitches without a rolled seam, one flat facet line shows low on one side. Colour variants are material swaps.
